title: Meta Plugin
description: Fluent API for managing the document head in CakePHP applications, with support for title and meta tags, Open Graph, canonical URLs, robots directives, performance hints, and structured data. Works through the Head helper and resolves metadata from page defaults, route options, runtime calls, and error pages.
name: Meta

title: Audit Plugin
description: Diagnoses common configuration, environment, and infrastructure problems in CakePHP applications before they reach users. One diagnostic, one check; issues that cannot be repaired safely are reported with clear remediation steps.
name: Audit

title: Explorator Plugin
description: Driver-based full-text search for CakePHP Tables and Entities. Built-in database and collection engines, plus Algolia, Meilisearch, and Typesense drivers, with queue sync and a TestSuite fake engine.
name: Explorator

title: MCP Plugin
description: Model Context Protocol server and client support for CakePHP. Expose tools, resources, prompts, and apps to AI agents over HTTP or STDIO, with OAuth 2.1 authentication.
name: Mcp

title: Ignis Plugin
description: AI-assisted CakePHP development with composable guidelines, on-demand agent skills, skill packs, and an MCP server for live application context.
name: Ignis

title: Speculum Plugin
description: Debug assistant for CakePHP applications. Records requests, exceptions, logs, queries, jobs, mail, and related runtime activity into a searchable dashboard, with a small MCP surface for agents.
name: Speculum

title: Scheduling Plugin
description: CakePHP task scheduling with a fluent cron-style API, sub-minute precision, overlap prevention, single-server locks, background execution, and before/after/success/failure hooks.
name: Scheduling

title: Queue Plugin
description: Dispatchable job helpers on top of cakephp/queue: self-dispatch, per-job queue configuration, tags, and pending/pushed events with an optional additive host emitter.
name: Queue

title: Tessera Plugin
description: Full OAuth2 server for CakePHP built on League OAuth2 Server. Authorization codes, client credentials, device grant, and personal access tokens with cakephp/authentication.
name: Tessera

title: Inspector Plugin
description: Package and stack detection for CakePHP projects. Reads lockfiles and optionally source to report dependencies, frontend stack, AI agents, editors, and codebase conventions.
name: Inspector

title: Essentia Plugin
description: Agent-optimized output for PHP tools in CakePHP projects. Detects AI agent environments and replaces verbose PHPUnit, Pest, Paratest, PHPStan, Rector, and PHPCS output with compact structured JSON. Cleans CakePHP console output automatically with zero configuration.
name: Essentia

title: Prompts Plugin
description: Laravel Prompts wrappers for CakePHP Console. Interactive CLI forms via Crustum/Prompts helpers, with native Windows ConsoleIo fallbacks when TTY prompts are unavailable.
name: Prompts
